parsed.name: 滨松科学相机
parsed.description: 这是一台滨松科学相机，用于实验中的高灵敏图像采集。它支持曝光时间、触发方式、采集模式以及子区域/分区读出设置，适合显微成像、光学测量和其他需要同步触发与快速连续采集的实验。
parsed.description_en: This is a Hamamatsu scientific camera used for sensitive image acquisition in laboratory experiments. It supports exposure control, trigger configuration, acquisition modes, and subarray/ROI readout, making it suitable for microscopy, optical measurements, and other experiments requiring synchronized triggering and rapid image capture.

actions.description: 初始化相机的控制参数与子区域读出相关设置。
actions.description_en: Initialize camera control parameters and subarray readout-related settings.

actions.description: 连接相机并加载当前的采集、触发和输出触发极性设置。
actions.description_en: Connect to the camera and load the current acquisition, trigger, and output trigger polarity settings.

actions.description: 断开相机连接并释放设备控制，同时恢复默认参数值。
actions.description_en: Disconnect the camera and release device control while restoring default parameter values.

actions.description: 在最佳偏移模式下将子区域位置设为不可修改，以避免错误更改。
actions.description_en: Make the subarray position non-editable in optimal offset mode to prevent unintended changes.

actions.description: 将当前相机采集与触发相关参数更新到设备中。
actions.description_en: Update the camera with the current acquisition- and trigger-related settings.
